channel.description: Notes on AI, code and building in public.

item.title: When AI Graphics Stop Looking Like AI: Teaching DANI Color, Type and Taste
item.description: Most AI graphics scream AI. The next leap is judgement: restrained color, real type hierarchy and composition a designer would sign off on. Here is what we are training DANI to do.

item.title: How Hackers Take Root on Your VPS Without You Ever Noticing
item.description: Your server keeps serving, your uptime stays perfect, and someone else has been root for months. How attackers get in, hide with rootkits, and how to catch them.

item.title: PHP2Shell: The Core PHP Vulnerability That Just Shook the Web
item.description: Two decades-old flaws in the PHP engine, turned into a working exploit by AI, forced emergency releases across the PHP world. Here is what PHP2Shell is, why it matters, and what to do right now.

item.title: Why 3D Modeling Is Great, and How DANI Will Do the Heavy Lifting for Game Devs
item.description: 3D modeling builds every game world you have ever played, and it is also the slowest link in the asset pipeline. Here is why it matters, and how DANI's realistic generation will carry the load for game developers.

item.title: Why You Should Join the DANI Waitlist
item.description: Early access before launch, founding-member pricing, and a say in how the platform is built. Here's what a free spot on the DANI waitlist actually gets you.

item.title: DANI AI and the Photorealism Leap: Why Realistic Image Generation Changes Everything
item.description: Photorealistic AI generation removes the camera, the studio and the budget from the equation. Here's why images that look real change how you build, market and sell.
